parsed.scene_description: An indoor space with large floor-to-ceiling windows revealing a multi-story building outside. A dark cylindrical column stands on the left. In front of it are white shelving units and a round table with blue-topped chairs. Along the window wall is a long wooden counter with additional seating. A red curved structure is partially visible on the far left edge.

objects.label: cylindrical column
objects.observation: Dark grey, tall cylindrical pillar located on the left side of the room. It appears to be a structural element with a smooth surface.

objects.label: white shelving unit
objects.observation: Stack of white, tiered shelving units positioned near the column. They hold various papers and items.

objects.label: round table
objects.observation: A round table with a light-colored top situated in the center-left area. It has thin legs and is surrounded by chairs.

objects.label: chair with blue seat
objects.observation: Multiple chairs with transparent or light-colored frames and blue circular seats are arranged around the table and along the window counter.

objects.label: window frame
objects.observation: Large black metal frames dividing glass panes that span from floor to ceiling. They enclose the view of the exterior building.

objects.label: wooden counter
objects.observation: A long wooden structure running along the right side of the room against the window wall. It serves as a barrier or desk.

objects.label: red curved structure
objects.observation: A bright red, curved architectural element partially visible on the extreme left edge of the frame.
